repos.name: Houston
repos.description: Houston, we have a solution. A consulting delivery platform built on Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.
repos.source: 5962b60625727381caba7234c0560bb2d3019877|Houston, we have a solution. A consulting delivery platform built on Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.|
repos.summary: A consulting delivery platform designed to manage the engagement lifecycle, including staffing, scoping, delivery, and post-go-live support.
highlights: Includes modules for consultant staffing, skills tracking, requirements management, and incident tracking with SLAs.
Features an integrated Dataverse data model covering Consultants, Clients, Engagements, and Skills.
Utilizes Power BI for real-time analytics on utilization, bench forecasting, and certification tracking.
Implements automated workflows for timesheet approvals, skill-gap alerts, and weekly reminders.

repos.name: DiogoS7.github.io
repos.summary: An interactive personal CV website featuring a solar-system themed journey through professional milestones and an AI-powered terminal for querying experience.
highlights: Custom canvas animation tracking career milestones via a solar-system theme
AI terminal using Cloudflare Workers AI to answer questions about professional experience
Automated GitHub Action that uses AI to generate and update project cards from READMEs
Responsive design with light/dark mode and skill-based project filtering

repos.name: Launchpad
repos.description: Employee onboarding app on Salesforce: BA documentation, data model, Flows and Agentforce
repos.source: c19a9d32d12d5fedfb65fefa808aa21a865d7390|Employee onboarding app on Salesforce: BA documentation, data model, Flows and Agentforce|
repos.summary: A Salesforce application designed to automate and manage the employee onboarding process for an IT consultancy.
highlights: Redesigned the onboarding process through AS-IS and TO-BE analysis to address specific business pain points.
Built using declarative tools, including record-triggered Flows for task generation and reminders.
Developed two custom Lightning Web Components for real-time progress tracking and KPI monitoring.
Implemented a full security model using permission sets and custom permissions to manage HR, Manager, and Employee personas.

repos.name: dronyDeliv
repos.description: Drone network management, layered on a package delivery network, built in Python
repos.source: b99e391421d6e6e66630c20d90483066b5bb5e36|Drone network management, layered on a package delivery network, built in Python|
repos.summary: A command-line scheduler for managing a drone delivery fleet and parcel orders.
highlights: Assigns drones to parcels based on zone, availability, autonomy, and weight capacity.
Generates updated fleet states and delivery timetables from input files.
Refactored into a tested, installable Python package with CI integration.

repos.name: Django-CRM
repos.description: Customer relationship manager built with Django
repos.summary: A customer relationship management system designed to track sales pipelines, customer records, and interaction histories.
highlights: Features a dashboard with pipeline breakdowns, activity timelines, and stage tracking.
Includes automated testing for core workflows and access control via GitHub Actions.
Implements secure configuration using environment variables and protected destructive actions.
Supports SQLite and MySQL databases through Django ORM.
